About me

Engineering with a people-first mindset

I’m pursuing a B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering at United International University, with a growing interest in software engineering and UI design. I enjoy turning ideas into working, usable products — from healthcare and donation applications to an agricultural robotics project.

Alongside my studies I’ve taken on leadership and HR roles in university organisations. That work taught me team coordination, clear communication and documentation, and it shapes how I approach technical teamwork.

I’m motivated by continuous learning and problem-solving, and by technology-driven solutions that make a practical difference.
